correctness.rationale: On Δ=G((B+2)²−4G)((B−2)²−4G)≠0 the smooth (2,2) bidegree curve has genus one. The coordinate Vieta involution and swap each have a fixed point and hence are elliptic reflections, so H is a translation. The projective boundary origin O=(∞,1) has H(O)=(-1,∞), H²(O)=(t,-1), H⁻¹(O)=(1,-t), t=(G−1)/B. Equality of boundary iterates yields order3 iff B≠0,G=1+B; order4 iff B=0 or G=1; and order5 iff F5=(G−1−B)(G−1+B)²−B³(G−1)=0, all restricted to Δ≠0 and excluding smaller orders. Independently expanded F5 under B=(t−1)(t+1)²/t, G=t(t²+t−1), obtaining zero, and factored Δ=(t−1)^5(t+1)^5(t²−4t−1)(t²+t−1)/t³. The birational inverse t=(G−1)/B proves rationality, B(t) degree three implies irreducible cubic F5, and the quartic j invariant has a pole at t→1 so is nonconstant. The source checker was read; finite sample cycles do not establish the classification.
